Own the organisation's patching and vulnerability management cycle — establishing a risk-based, structured approach to remediation across servers, endpoints, and core systems. Contribute to LIST's compliance and audit readiness from an operational perspective, ensuring that IT Operations can demonstrate control effectiveness to internal and external stakeholders. Asset, License & Vendor Management Own IT asset and configuration management, ensuring CMDB accuracy and lifecycle management Oversee software license management, ensuring compliance, cost optimisation, and vendor accountability Manage operational vendor relationships and service providers, ensuring performance against SLAs and contractual commitments Support budgeting, forecasting, and cost control related to IT operational services Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement Define, monitor, and report on service performance using KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and user satisfaction indicators Review trends, recurring incidents, and systemic issues, coordinating structured continuous service improvement initiatives Promote standardisation, reliability, and operational excellence across IT services Is Your profile described below? Demonstrated ability to define and execute an IT Operations strategy aligned with organisational goals — not just to manage existing processes. Experience contributing to senior IT leadership discussions: investment prioritisation, risk governance, and long-term service planning. Track record of driving organisational change through IT — whether through service model redesign, tooling transformation, or cultural shifts in how IT is consumed and valued. Proven experience managing Service Desk, End User Computing, and operational IT teams Demonstrated experience implementing and running ITSM processes and tools Practical exposure to IT security operations, system patching, and vulnerability remediation Solid technical understanding of enterprise IT environments (collaboration solutions, MS 365, endpoints, servers, networks, identity, applications) Strong service-oriented and risk-aware mindset, balancing usability, security, and operational stability Proven ability to manage incidents, security events, and operational escalations effectively Experience with asset, license, and configuration management in complex environments Experience in, or strong exposure to, compliance-driven environments (ISO 27001, NIS2, or equivalent) — relevant given LIST's regulatory context and the operational security scope of this role.
